content.query:
SELECT 
              AS_OF_DATE
            , FULLDATE
            , Previous_Business_Day
            , Business_Day_Flag
            , DAYOFYEAR
            , YEAR
            , CUST_ID
            , GAM_ACID
            , ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
            , GAM_BANK_ID
            , GAM_SCHM_TYPE
			, DATE_DIM.MONTH_END
            , EDS_CTL.*
          FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
        JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
            ON 1 = 1
            AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
			AND ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP'
        JOIN EDS.EDS_CTL
            ON DEPOSITS_DATE = AS_OF_DATE
        WHERE AS_OF_DATE =CAST('2023-09-02' AS DATE)
